import sys
from collections import defaultdict

MOD = 1000000007
INV100 = pow(100, MOD-2, MOD)

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    p = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            x = int(next(it))
            p[i][j] = x * INV100 % MOD

    # cur: dict mapping bitset (integer) to probability (mod)
    cur = {1: 1}  # only bit 0 set
    full_mask = (1 << n) - 1

    for i in range(n):
        nxt = defaultdict(int)
        for b, val in cur.items():
            # list of subset masks x that are present in b
            ones = [x for x in range(1 << n) if (b >> x) & 1]
            for e in range(1 << n):
                prob = 1
                for j in range(n):
                    if (e >> j) & 1:
                        prob = prob * p[i][j] % MOD
                    else:
                        prob = prob * (1 - p[i][j]) % MOD
                nb = 0
                for x in ones:
                    for r in range(n):
                        if ((e >> r) & 1) and not ((x >> r) & 1):
                            nb |= 1 << (x | (1 << r))
                nxt[nb] = (nxt[nb] + val * prob) % MOD
        cur = nxt

    ans = 0
    for b, val in cur.items():
        if (b >> full_mask) & 1:
            ans = (ans + val) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
